scope: POSTHOC optimization-horizon diagnosis after observing poor q-PCA768 5+5 deployment. First eight already-used systems only; no new independence or formal gate. Same q prior, same 60/100/140 Hz observed context, same query truth; bounded zero/one/three/five coarse and fine Gauss-Newton iterations. Purpose: determine whether high-rank q failure is simply late-iteration low-band overfitting. Reporting best query-error stage is descriptive DEV selection, not a deployable model selection protocol.
